counters.description: Outcomes of the latest sync session

delivered.description: Whether the app was online to receive the request

isCurrent.description: Active and matches the current text version

items.description: Latest record of every consent type

currentVersions.description: Current text version per consent type

version.description: Version of the consent text the user accepted

confirm.description: Must be `true`: the account and all data are deleted permanently

expiresAt.description: When the emailed link stops working

nextAvailableAt.description: When a new export can be requested

name.description: Display name of a user or admin actor

action.description: Domain event code; clients translate it

subject.description: Whose history the entry belongs to

purgeAt.description: When the data is erased for good

until.description: End of a temporary block; omit to block until unblocked

revokeSessions.description: End every active session right away

notify.description: Email the user that the account is blocked

currentWeek.description: 1-based week of the plan that contains today

title.description: Title the user or admin gave; clients name the type otherwise

status.description: Integration status, or `enabled` / `disabled` for the coach

hasAthlete.description: False when the user never set up the athlete profile; training blocks are then empty

target.description: Screen the app opens on tap

id.description: Entity of the target: coach session, workout or plan

title.description: Written title in the request language; null — clients show the sender of the category

body.description: Written text; null — clients render the type with `params`

read.description: Recipients who opened the notification in the app

platforms.description: Users with a push device of these platforms

activePlan.description: true — with an active plan, false — without one

recipients.description: Active accounts the broadcast would reach

withPush.description: Of them, with at least one push device

channels.description: Channels besides the inbox; empty — the inbox only
